next.reason: The OPEN rule: 1985 (1993 amendment) says 'the physical file is not affected', then a. the I-O status is set, then b. 'Any applicable USE AFTER EXCEPTION procedure is executed.' §2023:14.9.27.4 GR25 keeps that order: 'the file is not affected', a) I-O status set, d) the applicable USE procedure executed. Its new steps reach no 1985 program. Step b) applies only 'If it is enabled', and §2023:14.6.13.1.1 says 'By default, checking is not enabled for any exception condition'. Step c) needs an exception-checking PERFORM. §2023:14.9.49.4 GR6 runs the USE procedures when the statement 'was not specified within the scope of an exception-checking PERFORM statement'. This record matches the KEPT records for the identical VII and VIII rows. Catalog defect: this row's text also carries 1993 erratum text for READ GR10b, GR10c and GR11b (IX-30/IX-31). That text belongs to the READ statement, has no row of its own, and is not decided here.
